fmiModelDescription.description: SOFA reference organ (20 mm budget-fit mesh, 1230 tetrahedra) with a tip-to-node penalty tool coupling. One DoStep is one SOFA solver step at dt 0.001 s. Cut events are outside this FMU contract (see README).
fmiModelDescription.author: Seth Nenninger

Category.name: mechanical_sofa
Category.description: Worker start, pipe, and step diagnostics

Float64.name: time
Float64.description: Simulation time (FMU time)

Float64.name: tool_stiffness
Float64.description: Penalty stiffness of the tip-to-node coupling (point spring from the tool tip to the organ coupling node)

Float64.name: tip_x
Float64.description: Tool-tip position x in the scene frame (scene y superior)

Float64.name: tip_y
Float64.description: Tool-tip position y in the scene frame

Float64.name: tip_z
Float64.description: Tool-tip position z in the scene frame

Float64.name: tip_qx
Float64.description: Tool-tip orientation quaternion x (unit quaternion, echoed)

Float64.name: tip_qy
Float64.description: Tool-tip orientation quaternion y (echoed)

Float64.name: tip_qz
Float64.description: Tool-tip orientation quaternion z (echoed)

Float64.name: tip_qw
Float64.description: Tool-tip orientation quaternion w (echoed)

Float64.name: force_x
Float64.description: Force on the tool, x (organ on tool)

Float64.name: force_y
Float64.description: Force on the tool, y

Float64.name: force_z
Float64.description: Force on the tool, z

Float64.name: torque_x
Float64.description: Torque on the tool about the tip, x (zero for the point coupling)

Float64.name: torque_y
Float64.description: Torque on the tool about the tip, y

Float64.name: torque_z
Float64.description: Torque on the tool about the tip, z

Float64.name: pose_x
Float64.description: Tool-tip pose position x (applied)

Float64.name: pose_y
Float64.description: Tool-tip pose position y (applied)

Float64.name: pose_z
Float64.description: Tool-tip pose position z (applied)

Float64.name: pose_qx
Float64.description: Tool-tip pose quaternion x (applied)

Float64.name: pose_qy
Float64.description: Tool-tip pose quaternion y (applied)

Float64.name: pose_qz
Float64.description: Tool-tip pose quaternion z (applied)

Float64.name: pose_qw
Float64.description: Tool-tip pose quaternion w (applied)

Float64.name: max_disp
Float64.description: Maximum nodal displacement magnitude over all organ nodes

Float64.name: mean_disp
Float64.description: Mean nodal displacement magnitude over all organ nodes

Float64.name: tip_node_disp
Float64.description: Displacement magnitude of the organ coupling node

Float64.name: step_count
Float64.description: Completed SOFA solver steps since the last start of the worker
